Underworld Grimoire 2 or better, or runes for the Ungael Teleport necromancy incantation
Activated Menaphos lodestone or Pharaoh's sceptre or Sceptre of the Gods or Leela's favour
Coins for the magic carpet or:
Pollnivneach Teleport scroll or ring of slaying
Desert amulet 2 or better for teleports to Nardah
Leela's favour for getting around Menaphos

kills.t: Four waves of monsters who use melee, ranged, and magic

rewards.t: Access to Amascut, the Devourer boss fight
The quest variant will also be considered a normal mode kill count for the purpose of Reaper Crew
You may also replay the version of the fight from the quest by speaking with Icthlarin in the Imperial District afterwards.
Desert outfit for the Lorehound pet
Improved experience from divine carpet dust; it now provides 10% of the experience that would be received from rubbing a medium XP lamp
Access to the fourth room in the Sunken Pyramid (can be purchased from Slayer Rewards for 3,000 Slayer points)
Four demigod boons activated from the statues in Menaphos plaza. (These are toggled off by default after completing the quest; all four boons can be toggled on simultaneously for permanent effects.)
Boon of Het: Increases life points by 5% base life points
Boon of Apmeken: Gives any nearby players a 1% experience boost for one hour via any emote
Boon of Crondis: 2% chance of gathering an additional material while skilling
Boon of Scabaras: Completing any clue scroll gives a 1% chance of finishing the trail

steps.t: Enter the Golden Palace in Menaphos. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Speak with Leela inside the pyramid. [Chat: Accept]
Speak with Leela outside the pyramid.
Cross the bridge to Sophanem and speak with Ozan. [Chat: 1 Yes. › ~]
Speak with the following citizens (if you need to leave the area to visit a bank, you will need to talk to Ozan again to proceed):

sub.t: The Sphinx (west of larger pyramid, cat is required but catspeak amulet is not required for quest progression. Your cat must be following you in order to progress dialogue.)
Raetul (north-east of larger pyramid; by silk stall)
Nathifa, south of the Sophanem Slayer Dungeon (must speak to the other 4 before Nathifa dialogue progresses) [Chat: 3 What proposition? (Continue quest) › ~]

steps.t: Speak to Ozan and prepare well for an intense battle which includes four waves of multiple heavy hitting enemies and stuns. Death is unsafe here.
Go to the Sophanem Slayer Dungeon and inspect the dungeon entrance.

sub.t: If this option does not appear, speak to Ozan again.

steps.t: Defeat four waves of soul devourers. You may need to speak to Het or Apmeken to continue receiving waves. If you die, you will have to restart all waves.
Talk to Het or Apmeken and finish the dialogue.
Return to Ozan and finish the dialogue.
Speak to Scabaras in the Temple of Isolation with at least 1 backpack space. [Chat: 3 (Continue quest)]

sub.t: The entrance to the temple is north of Pollnivneach in the Scabarite Cavern, where you can use the old boat.

steps.t: Head to Het's Oasis and speak to Het (outside west entrance) to continue the quest and be transported to the agility course.

sub.t: There is a possible graphical bug. After talking to Het to continue the quest, your screen will remain black. Re-log and talk to Het again to fix.

steps.t: Talk to Het to be tasked with doing the agility course.
Complete 1 lap of the agility course (from your current location) by climbing the rope ladder.
Start a new lap on the course until you get back to Crondis and Het.
Speak to Het by the rope ladder.
Gather 1 of each flower from the perfect flower bushes in each corner of Het's Oasis, do not teleport as you will need to speak with Het again. Each one will be marked with a light beam.
Speak to Crondis by the rope ladder.
Go to the monkey colony north-east of the Bandit Camp and talk to Apmeken with a monkeyspeak amulet or cramulet equipped.
Run slightly north (somewhere quieter) and talk to Apmeken again. [Chat: 3 We could go get a chimp ice? (Continue quest)]
Head to choc ice stall in Nardah and speak to Rokuh.

sub.t: You may teleport to Nardah using a desert amulet 2 or higher.
Buying choc Ice without speaking to him will not progress the quest.
If Apmeken is not following you, he will not give you the Ice. Return to the monkey colony and speak to Apmeken.

steps.t: Head back to the monkey colony and continue quest (unlike other instances, players may teleport without the item melting, and ice spells are not required).
Kill Mizaru, Kikazaru and Iwazaru.

sub.t: Remember to kill the demons for Kikazaru; beware Iwazaru can unequip your helmet to the backpack.

steps.t: Speak to Apmeken in the Monkey Colony to receive Apmeken's Favour.
Speak to Scabaras in the Temple of Isolation.
Puzzle solution:
Talk to Memory of Tumeken.
Open the gate.

steps.t: Move:
Move:
Open the gate.
Open sarcophagus.
Talk to memory of Tumeken.
Talk to Scabaras (down the first set of stairs to the south) - Make sure to finish the dialogue, there's a brief animation.
Head to Menaphos and speak to Pharaoh Leela at the top of the stairs north-west of the Menaphos lodestone, not inside the throne room.
Speak to Pharaoh Leela twice.
Speak to Urluk and the council south west of Leela.
Speak to the four aspects (Het, Apmeken, Scabaras, and Crondis), then Commander Akhomet.

sub.t: If Crondis does not respond to your clicks, move to the south side of the pool edge, and try again.

steps.t: Speak to Leela. [Chat: 1 I am. › 5 Akhomet's forces. › 1 Apmeken's forces. › 2 Het's forces › 2 Scarabas' forces]
Speak to Icthlarin. [Chat: 5 Continue Quest.]
Go to the Ungael ritual site.
Take beacon from the soul beacon north of the Archivist. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Place the soul beacon (corrupted) on the pedestal of the ritual site and draw the corresponding glyphs for the ensoul beacon ritual.
Perform ritual, closing shadow rifts as they appear.

sub.t: If you're unable to start the ritual, attempt to take the soul beacon again.

steps.t: Interact with the soul beacon west of the ritual site.
Go to the Um Ritual Site and continue the quest via the portal. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk with Vorkath, then to Icthlarin.
Place the soul beacon on the pedestal and perform the powerful ritual of severance. Simply ignore the creatures that appear - Vorkath and Icthlarin will deal with them.
Prepare for the encounter of Amascut, the Devourer.
When you're ready, return to the Um Ritual Site and speak to Icthlarin to continue.
Run through the city to the Great Pyramid and speak to any of the lesser gods for a cutscene.
Speak to Tumeken, click through all the chat options to continue. [Chat: 1 What are you? › 2 Why is everyone frozen? › 3 Why are you speaking to me? › 4 Continue.]
The fight then begins with Amascut. Attack the soul obelisks, she switches between magic, ranged, and melee attacks. During the last phase, you will be teleported onto a platform.
p: Het and Apmeken arrive to aid you.
Amascut performing her Shadow Dash attack

Finish the remaining dialogue. [Chat: ~]
